Who I Am

The Editor Behind the Cuts

From timeline to final render, I bring precision and creativity to every project.

Hi, I'm Morfi 👋

I'm a mid-level motion designer and video editor based in Egypt, passionate about transforming ideas into visually stunning stories. Whether it's a fast-paced social media edit or a cinematic motion graphics piece, I bring the same dedication to every frame.

I'm not just cutting and editing videos — I'm crafting evolution with the client, partnering in taking the channel from average or good to the absolute best. Choosing me means you need to level up your work quality.

My workflow is built on flexibility and compatibility — I adapt to any project style, timeline, or creative direction. From color grading to complex motion graphics, I handle the full post-production pipeline.

What I Do

Services I Offer

From raw footage to final delivery, I cover the full post-production spectrum.

🎬

Video Editing

Professional editing for commercials, YouTube, social media, and corporate videos. Cuts that flow with purpose and rhythm.

✨

Motion Graphics

Animated logos, lower thirds, transitions, and full motion packages that elevate your brand's visual identity.

🎨

Color Grading

Cinematic color correction and grading to set the mood, match scenes, and give your footage a professional film look.

📱

Social Media Content

Short-form content optimized for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts with trending styles and fast turnarounds.

🔊

Sound Design

Audio cleanup, music selection, sound effects, and mixing to ensure your video sounds as good as it looks.

🎓

Motion Design Instruction

One-on-one tutoring and workshops for aspiring motion designers covering After Effects, principles, and workflow optimization.
